text: E5 was the first model to outperform the strong BM25 baseline on the BEIR zero-shot retrieval benchmark without using any labeled data [S1][S2]. On the MIRACL benchmark, M3-Embedding's sparse retrieval functionality outperforms BM25 [S5]. However, M3-Embedding (Sparse) performs poorly compared to other methods in cross-lingual settings because there are very limited co-existed terms between queries and passages in different languages [S3][S6].
